sara: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/534 1 clarifies quota header names, adds a tiny SDK example, and a Grafana snippet. Need a quick review before EOD.

ben: quick scan. Are we using 'rate-limit-*' everywhere now? Support is still seeing 'x-rate-limit-*' in older SDKs.

sara: infra changed names last year. PR includes a short migration callout: legacy `x-rate-limit-*` -> new `rate-limit-*` and shows a compatibility snippet.

olga: paste the snippet here so I can sanity-check casing.

sara: snippet from PR:```js
// read headers compatibly
const rem = res.headers.get('rate-limit-remaining') || res.headers.get('x-rate-limit-remaining');
const reset = res.headers.get('rate-limit-reset') || res.headers.get('x-rate-limit-reset');
```

ben: looks good. small nit 1 add units to the dashboard panel subtitle (tokens/min). Also switch the hardcoded region in the Grafana JSON to $env_region.

sara: done both and fixed a broken image path. Pushed. @docs-bot can you run the lint checks?

docs-bot: CI queued: docs-lint, linkcheck. docs-lint failed 1 two code fences missing language tags.

sara: fixed fences and re-pushed.

infra-bot: linkcheck passed. docs-lint passed.

ben: approving now. merge at 1869502490. closing thread. :tada:
